description: This file defines the NotificationsContactsClient class, an AWS SDK client for interacting with the AWS User Notifications Contacts service. It includes method annotations for various contact management actions and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: NotificationsContactsClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS User Notifications Contacts service, providing methods for contact management and contact-related operations.

methods.name: activateEmailContact
methods.description: Activates an email contact in the notifications system.

methods.name: getEmailContact
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific email contact.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: sendActivationCode
methods.description: Sends an activation code to a contact.
